  A1 processes 40%, the second assistant A2 processes 35%, and the third assistant A3 processes 25% of  
  the mails. The first assistant has an error rate of 0.04, the second has an error rate of 0.06 and the third (3)

  company wishes to know the probability that the mail was processed by first assistant.
